notes: Wind warning for Avalon coastal waters. Vessel movements restricted for craft under 50m. Container terminal operating at reduced throughput. Cargo crane ops suspended above 65 kph.
Inland wind warning across Avalon Peninsula. Feeder line loading approaching design limits. Pre-existing equipment defect on Feeder 7 flagged for monitoring. No outages confirmed yet.
Wind warning for Labrador plateau. Surface haul road conditions deteriorating. Open-pit equipment approaching wind rating thresholds. Mine site on elevated watch. No access road closures yet.

Rapid intensification. All vessel movements fully suspended. Storm surge warning issued for St. John's harbour. Fuel pier boom barrier operating beyond rated wave height. Life safety risk for any outdoor crew.

Ice accretion confirmed on Feeder Line 7 transmission infrastructure. Transformer TX-7 failure imminent under combined ice and wind loading. Controlled load shedding required. Repair crew access blocked by road conditions.

Blizzard conditions at Voisey's Bay. Transport NL has closed the only access road. All helicopter operations suspended. Site fully isolated. 142 personnel on site — headcount and shelter confirmation required.

Storm passing. Advisory-level winds remain. Structural assessment required before cargo cranes return to service. First vessel berth window expected 18:00–20:00 subject to harbour inspection clearance.
Heavy post-storm rainfall. Flooding risk to low-lying substations. Route 60 wash-out reported — delays replacement crew access to Feeder Line 7 by 3 hours. Conditions otherwise improving.
Conditions improving at Voisey's Bay. Road assessment underway via tracked vehicle. Estimated 12–18 hours to restore wheeled vehicle access. Helicopter window expected to open by 16:00.
